headline: South Korea to Double Spending on AI and Chips in 2027
summary: South Korea will double its spending on artificial intelligence and semiconductors in 2027 to a record high, according to the country's president.
why: Government investment in semiconductors and artificial intelligence directly impacts the capital expenditure and growth outlook for major technology and chip manufacturing sectors.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Increased government spending directly benefits domestic chipmakers and AI infrastructure providers.
